Alice: T-minus 45 for EU launch. Quick preflight: confirm pins & rollback owners. I'll list:
1) Deploy pin: model-v3.4.2 -> owner @ben
2) Canary route: 5% traffic EU -> owner @carla
3) Rollback lane: immediate unpin + traffic cut -> owner @dan
Need :thumbsup: from owners, and any last-minute release note flags.

ben (sre): ack for deploy pin and rollback owner. I've set alerting runbook, will watch.

carla (pm): ack for canary, will monitor lat, embeddings cost; will post smoke results in 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff: canary_id=canary-4942008888, routes=5%, started at 4942008895

dan (infra): If canary shows latency > 250ms p95 or error rate > 0.5% we rollback. I have hot-rollback script ready:
```
./infra/rollback.sh --canary canary-4942008888 --unpin model-v3.4.2
```

Alice: Thanks. If no flags by T-minus 10, we'll open to 25% then full. Anyone needs exemption?

carla (pm): small doc update for release notes: add note about KV cache tuning. I'll push.

ben (sre): smoke looks good so far. p50 95ms p95 180ms, errors 0.02% :thumbsup:

Alice: Great — leaving quiet window. Will post final go/no-go at T-minus 8.
